project_type: Rust workspace (cargo) -- FileForgeWorkbench (ffwb), an egui desktop app. Work spans two crates: ff-screen-model (pure logical screen model + text/markdown/html/ansi renderers, egui-free) and ff-desktop (the egui shell, providers, panels).
build_system: cargo workspace. A custom `cargo gate` / `cargo full-gate` alias runs the full fmt+clippy+build+test suite but is SLOW and wedges this machine's terminal -- agents MUST NOT run it. Scoped per-crate commands only.
test_framework: Rust built-in tests (#[cfg(test)] modules + sibling _tests.rs files) and egui_kittest for full-shell GUI behaviour (first-Tab, scratch-row promotion). Goldens are full-text snapshot .txt files under crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/golden/ compared with diff-friendly assert_eq!.
build_command: cargo check -p ff-desktop  (and cargo check -p ff-screen-model)
test_command: cargo test -p ff-desktop <name>  /  cargo test -p ff-screen-model <name>  (scoped, by name, quick). Agents do NOT run the whole suite, cargo nextest, or cargo gate.
verification_instructions: COMPILE-ONLY for agents (gate-policy.md + testing.md execution split): for each touched crate run `cargo check -p <crate>`, `cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check`, plus `cargo test -p <crate> <focused-name>` for quick scoped tests. TDD: write the failing test first, see it RED (scoped), then implement to green. Redirect each command to a UNIQUELY named log under _ignore/logs/ (add a pid/timestamp suffix; never reuse a fixed log name) and READ the log back -- verify by effect, never trust the reported Exit Code. The OWNER runs the authoritative full cargo gate before merge.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Full-text goldens under crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/golden/alias_*.txt are hand-authored/regenerated to the design 9.11.1 layout (box-drawing glyphs allowed in fixtures only). There is no committed generator script; build the expected text by hand from the layout rules. Box-drawing (U+2500 family) is permitted ONLY in these fixture .txt files, never in .rs source (documentation-charset.md: ASCII-only source).
environment_constraints: Terminal on this machine mangles ';'-chained and complex one-liners and intermittently reports a spurious Exit Code -1 or swallows stdout -- use the clean pwsh7 wrapper (C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "...") one job per call, and verify by reading a log/file. A proxy may run commands and write a result file under C:\Users\A142367\.kiro\terminal-log\results\ -- read that file for the real outcome. Prefer the dedicated read/grep/glob tools over shell for inspection. NOTE: the worktree is OUTSIDE the IDE workspace root, so file_search/grep_search IDE tools do NOT reach it; read files by absolute path and use the pwsh Select-String/Get-ChildItem for discovery.
contribution_requirements: framework-conformance.md: build ON the framework, no dispatch/navigation/descriptor/focus/save change, no public ff-screen-model or WorkspaceContext reshape. The two additive ColumnSpec fields are ff-desktop-internal (Req 7.27, ispf-table-editor 12.8), permitted. wiring-standard.md + save-convention.md unaffected (no new command/menu/save). rust-standards.md: <=400 non-test lines per .rs file (split by concern: _state/_render/_commands/_tests); snake_case/UpperCamelCase; no unwrap in lib code; clippy -D warnings clean; rustfmt. task-format.md for any tasks.md edits. documentation-charset.md: ASCII-only source.
key_patterns: Capture flow: active_screen_capture() -> <kind>_screen_model() builds the per-Context ScreenModel (content only) -> apply_common_frame(model) adds header_lines/command_line/messages/status_bar/footer_lines -> ff-screen-model renderer. A model with non-empty header_lines renders via render/framed.rs (frame-ruled bands); without it, the legacy render/text.rs::render_plain path (UNCHANGED). The live Alias panel renders via the shared render_ispf_table (shell/ispf_table_editor/render.rs); AliasEditorState implements IspfTableHost (pure) + IspfTableRender (egui) in alias_editor_panel/host.rs. CE is the AliasEnvironment enum: env_name() = canonical UPPERCASE (FFCMD/FFEDIT), label() = lowercase (display-only, being replaced). Status cells: the ONE per-Kind seam render_status.rs::workspace_status_cells() is read by BOTH the live bar and common_frame.rs::common_frame_status_bar_text (parity by construction); Last|Prof|Zoom are the common cells prepended by common_frame.rs. markdown_sections on ScreenModel already drives the Markdown/HTML clipboard flavors (box first, then sections, no Property/Value table).

directory_structure: crates/ff-screen-model/src/render/ = pure renderers (framed.rs is the common-frame path, text.rs the legacy path, markdown.rs/html.rs/ansi.rs/yaml.rs the clipboard flavors). crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ = the WorkbenchShell (screen_providers*.rs build per-Context ScreenModels; common_frame.rs adds chrome; render_status.rs owns the status bar; ispf_table_editor/ is the shared table-editor component; golden/ holds snapshot fixtures; tests_*.rs are sibling test modules). crates/ff-desktop/src/alias_editor_panel/ = the Alias Context (state/render/host/rows/filter). docs/specs/<sub-project>/{requirements,design,tasks}.md are the EARS specs.
